Nepal Flood Devastation: Schools Reopen Amid National Mourning

Nepal is reopening 65 schools to help children cope with the trauma of a devastating flood. The nation observed a 13th day of mourning for the disaster, which has left thousands of homes destroyed and claimed over 1,340 lives. The national flag flew at half-mast during the period of mourning.
